'''Vasteg''' was a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Forger (profession)/Legends|forger]] who based his operations out of [[Sliteye's Entertainment Emporium]]. He was capable of forging [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|Bureau of Ships and Services]] permits.<ref name="Game" />
